H20a.claim: Primary face-value repricing becomes more frequent as the show approaches.
H20a.test: LPM: move ~ 1[0-6 days] + 1[7-13] + 1[14-29] (reference 30+ days) + event FE + snapshot-date FE (absorbs year). One-sided test that the 0-6-day coefficient > 0.

H20b.claim: Primary face-value changes are steps, not continuous drift: on a typical day the face range does not change.
H20b.test: Intercept-only regression of move on the event-day pairs (snapshot-date FE, year); H0: daily move rate >= 5% (drift-like), one-sided; reject if the upper 95% bound < 5%.

H9p.claim: Events with wide primary price spreads (max/min >= 3 on the path's first day, a proxy for platinum/tiered pricing) reprice more often.
H9p.test: LPM: move ~ wide_spread + days-to-show bucket dummies + snapshot-date FE (year); two-sided test on wide_spread. wide_spread is measured as of the first path day (no look-ahead).

H37.claim: Primary face-value changes concentrate around scheduled sale-phase dates (public on-sale start, presale windows) rather than spreading evenly over days to show.
H37.test: LPM: move ~ near_sale_phase (snapshot within 3 days after a public_sale_start or presale start/end recorded as of the previous snapshot) + days-to-show bucket dummies + snapshot-date FE (year); one-sided test that near_sale_phase > 0.

common: Sample: events with a complete priced 30-day path (first snapshot >= 30 days out, valid range on the path's first day, at most 3 of 31 days missing). Unit: event-day pairs (consecutive days, both priced). move = |change| > $0.005 in min or max face value. Weights: none in base; 1/selection_prob in 'IPW (selection)'. SE clustered by artist (first attraction id); p and 95% CI from t(G_eff - 1); null-imposed wild cluster bootstrap (Webb, 1,999 draws) and leave-one-artist-out range if G_eff < 30.
disclosure: declared after the 3-day descriptive move rates were computed; no estimate of any member existed
